goal: Build a compact, responsive bakery website that turns today's laminated pastry selection into a real weekend pickup reservation interaction.
brandTruth: Soft Crumb makes small-batch laminated pastries with seasonal fillings for Saturday and Sunday pickup.
audienceAndMoment: A local customer planning a weekend treat before Friday's order cutoff.
primaryAction: Choose pastries and reserve a Saturday or Sunday pickup window.
contentInventory: pickup days, hours, cutoff, and address
shared bag state and reservation success
requiredInteractions: open and close the shared bag
show a mutually exclusive success state

assetReality.dominantFoodAssets: Generated specifically for this implementation as chroma-key raster sources, converted locally to alpha WebP.
assetReality.fonts: Local OFL-licensed Instrument Serif and Libre Franklin WOFF2 files.
assetReality.brandMark: Semantic text wordmark; no supplied logo exists.

constraints: works at desktop, tablet, and mobile widths
semantic controls and visible keyboard focus
no improvised SVG food or decorative product art
generated direction frames remain creative references rather than pixel specifications
no payment or network submission in the demo
antiReferences: centered headline and two CTA stack
floating pastry decoration unrelated to composition
excessive clay, glow, blur, or neumorphic effects
desktop columns merely stacked on mobile

visualReference.selectionNote: The user asked to proceed with a small bakery implementation after reviewing the new Design Lagann visual-orientation result. This implementation uses the deterministic Direction A recommendation without mutating the fixture's separate pending-approval record.

successEvidence: local fonts and raster assets load
bag count, product quantities, and totals stay synchronized
day and time selection produce one success state
keyboard and reduced-motion behavior are usable
rendered screenshots preserve the pastry-and-paper hinge
